narrative.overview:
The site is set like a printed binary phase-diagram plate kept in a tidy research notebook. Materials science and software are the two components of one system and sit on one axis; everything else is hairlines, ticks, small labels, and numbered rows. The ground is a cool plate white with graphite ink, and a single steel-blue line marks what is live: links, focus, axis boundaries, and data points.

Density is that of a notebook index, not a landing page. Content lives in one left-aligned column of about 40rem, with a 9rem margin column for dates and indices on wider screens. There are no cards, no shadows, no rounded corners, and no decorative imagery; figures appear only when a project or post supplies them, and they are numbered and captioned like plates in a report. Motion is a 150ms colour or stroke change on hover and focus, removed under reduced motion.

Light is the default; dark mode follows the system and becomes a graphite plate with chalk ink, keeping the same line grammar.
keyCharacteristics: One Korean workhorse sans (Pretendard) on a fixed stepped scale, tabular figures for dates and indices.
Structure through 1px hairline rules, never through fills or elevation.
Steel blue is a signal, not a decoration.
Categories and fields are expressed as line forms (solid, dashed, double), never as coloured chips.
Numbered notebook rows with a provenance line on every entry.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Steel blue is reserved for links on hover/focus and current state, focus rings, axis boundaries, and data points. It is never a fill, a background, or a heading colour.

rules.name: The Ink Ladder Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy of text is carried by three ink steps (ink, ink-2, ink-3), not by extra hues.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every date, index, count, and measured value uses tabular numerals so columns of numbers align like a lab table.

rules.name: The Fixed Step Rule
rules.body: Only the six size tokens exist; only the display step is fluid.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px rule in hairline grey. If something needs to feel grouped, add space or a rule, never a shadow or a fill.

dos: Do separate content with 1px hairline-grey rules and whitespace from the spacing scale.
Do set every date, index, count, and measurement in tabular figures at label size.
Do give every entry a provenance line: category or field, then the original Velog or GitHub link.
Do mark field and category with a line form: solid for 재료과학, dashed for 소프트웨어, double for 재료 + 코드.
Do number figures "그림 n." with the caption below the image in ink-3 label type.
Do keep steel blue to links on hover and focus, the current state, focus rings, axis boundaries, and data points.
Do keep hit targets at least 44px for navigation and the original-article link, and remove transitions under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use shadows, rounded corners, or filled card containers.
Don't express categories, fields, or states as coloured chips or badges.
Don't introduce a second accent colour or use steel blue as a fill or heading colour.
Don't add decorative imagery or hero banners; images appear only as numbered figures supplied by content.
Don't add type sizes outside the six-step scale.
